Trainable self-attention over a sequence tensor.

Connect one sequence tensor to Query. Studio uses it as query, key, and value. For attention over another sequence use the Cross Attention node; attention masks remain fail-closed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Attention](../categories/attention.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `MultiHeadAttention` |
| Search words | attention, transformer, self-attention |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Query** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Sequence tensor [batch, sequence, features], used as query, key, and value. |
| **Key** | Tensor | No | 1 | Not used: connecting it is rejected; use the Cross Attention node. |
| **Value** | Tensor | No | 1 | Not used: connecting it is rejected; use the Cross Attention node. |
| **Mask** | Tensor | No | 1 | Reserved for attention masking; connecting this pin is currently rejected. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Self-attention output [batch, sequence, features]. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Attention | Embedding Dimension | `embed_dim` | Integer | `512` | `1-65536` | The run | Expected input feature width. Required. |
| Attention | Attention Heads | `num_heads` | Integer | `8` | `1-4096` | The run | Number of attention heads; embed_dim must divide evenly. Required. |
| Regularization | Dropout | `dropout` | Number | `0.0` | `0.0-0.999` | The run | Attention dropout probability. |
| Advanced | Use Bias | `use_bias` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Enable bias in the attention projections. Advanced. |
| Attention | Causal | `causal` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Hide future positions (decoder / language-model attention). Off = bidirectional (encoder). |
| Attention | Position Encoding | `position_encoding` | Choice | `none` | `none`, `rope`, `alibi` | The run | none (positions come from elsewhere), rope (rotary embedding on queries and keys) or alibi (linear distance penalty; needs causal). |
| Attention | QK Norm | `qk_norm` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Per-head RMSNorm of queries and keys before the scores (OLMo 2, Gemma 3, Qwen3). |
| Attention | Key/Value Heads | `num_kv_heads` | Integer | `0` | `0-4096` | The run | Key/value heads for grouped-query attention; 0 = num_heads. Must divide num_heads. |
| Attention | RoPE Base | `rope_base` | Number | `10000` | `1.0-10000000.0` | The run | Rotary frequency base (theta). Advanced. |
| Attention | RoPE Fraction | `rope_fraction` | Number | `1.0` | `0.01-1.0` | The run | Fraction of each head's features that RoPE rotates. Advanced. |
| Attention | Sliding Window | `sliding_window` | Integer | `0` | `0-1048576` | The run | Causal sliding window; 0 = full. Advanced. |
| Attention | Logit Soft-cap | `attn_logit_softcap` | Number | `0` | `0.0-1000.0` | The run | Logit soft-cap cap \* tanh(scores / cap); 0 = off. Advanced. |
| Fine-tuning | Frozen | `frozen` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Keeps this layer's weights as they are while the rest of the model trains: no gradient step, no weight decay, no optimizer memory. Use it on layers that start from a weights file (fine-tuning), then turn it off to train them too. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as a trainable CPU-backed self-attention layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Current Studio execution uses Input as Query, Key, and Value. The legacy Key, Value, and Mask pins are reserved and fail closed when connected.
```

## Tips

- embed_dim must be divisible by num_heads.
- 8 heads is typical, 12-16 for larger models.
